custom_oauth.help_step_1:
- **Create a new app**
- **Configure Workato to talk to your app**
  - Copy following values from your app to the custom OAuth profile:
    - `Client ID`
    - `Client secret`
    - Press `Create` button to save your changes. *You have to complete this before you go to the next step.*
custom_oauth.help_step_2:
- Create and register an OAuth app to be used in this custom OAuth profile. This is usually in the ‘developer’ section of your chosen app
- Fill in the relevant fields to create or register a new app, here are some values that may be required in the process:
  - Redirect URL/Redirect URI/Callback URL: *https://www.workato.com/oauth/callback*
  - App URL/website URL: *https://www.workato.com*
- Add all relevant scopes to the app

  - Go to *Interactivity & Shortcuts/Interactivity*
  - Paste in https://www.workato.com/slack_webhooks/actions?sa_scope=adapter&coak_id={{customOauthKey.id}}
  - Click **Save Changes**

  - Go to *OAuth & Permissions/Scopes/User Token Scopes*
  - Add the scopes you have selected in the **OAuth user scopes** field of the connection. If no scopes are selected, add the following default scopes:
    - channels:read
    - channels:write
    - chat:write
    - groups:read
    - groups:write
    - im:read
    - im:write
    - mpim:read

Click **Save** - Under **Configure > Branding**, add your genie avatars - Under **Configure > Domains**, click **Add a domain** and enter `*.workato.com` - Add the bot to your app, and configure the bot's permissions - Under **Configure > App features > Bot**, select your bot - Under **What can your bot do?**, select `Upload and download files` - Under **Select the scopes where people can use your bot**, select `Personal`, `Team`, and `Group Chat` - **Scopes**: Check `Personal`, `Team`, and `Group Chat` - Click **Save** - Configure your app in the Azure portal - Navigate to your Azure portal - In the search bar, enter `App Registrations` and select the result -
